name: thai
note: Thai runs measured on Noto Sans Thai, the Thai-capable face registered at user level (~/.local/share/fonts, fc-cache) and mirrored by the engine's registration (fonts/NotoSansThai-Regular.ttf). Chrome's fontconfig resolves 'Noto Sans Thai' to the installed file and the engine shapes the same file, so advances agree to sub-pixel. Reclassified out of known-gaps (the registered set previously had no Thai face, so skia's fallback and Chrome's fontconfig fallback resolved the run to different fonts).
